name: Tomato & Basil Pesto Tuna Melts with Italian Mixed Green Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Drain tuna, place in a medium bowl, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 4 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Drain and mince capers. Add to the bowl with the tuna along with pesto, mayo, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp capers
½ cup basil pesto
¼ cup mayonnaise
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange bread slices on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping once, until lightly toasted, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tomatoes
1 English cucumber
1 (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Slice tomatoes into thin rounds. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide tuna salad between toast slices and spread out in an even layer; top with tomato slices and sprinkle with cheese.
Return toasts the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide tuna melts and mixed greens between plates; top greens with cucumber and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
